title: Cookie Store
description:
Welcome to the Cookie Store!Would you be interested in a cute, happy, and colorful life as a cafe owner? You can find it in this Visual Novel! Please take a look at our menu below.Menu:• get closer to your employees and friends
- 6 different character routes

• three possible endings of the main story
- but the game will not end there...

• uplifting music and colorful art
- partially animated characters
- 14 illustrations and characters gallery to unlock

• test your skills and... luck
- simple minigame simulating financial progress (tutorial included)

Full course might take about 3 hours or more (all routes, depending on reading speed and time in minigames)
description_short: Running a cafe is not an easy job. Especially when you're not making profits. Comedy, romance, friendship, and business combine in this unique Visual Novel!
